market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and choppy. Oil-driven yield spikes create whipsaw in equities. S&P 500 range-bound as Big Tech support offsets yield pressure. Hormuz headlines dominate daily moves. Dollar strength pressures EM. Expect 3-5% volatility in energy and rate-sensitive sectors.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle and defense spending provide structural equity support. 5% yield regime normalizes valuations, favoring quality earnings over growth-at-any-price. China trade truce and EV technology race create selective opportunities. Housing remains a drag. Iran war resolution is the key swing factor.
